title: Clipboard history
description: Records what you copy (text, images, files, links, colours) so the Clipboard palette can find and paste it again. Runs from launch; nothing leaves the machine.

settings.label: Exclude apps
settings.description: Bundle ids (com.1password.1password): copies made while one of these is in front are not recorded, and entries recorded from one before it was added are not listed. Read at launch.

settings.label: Keep entries
settings.description: How many unpinned entries history keeps; older ones past this are deleted on the next copy. Read at launch.

settings.label: Keep for
settings.description: Unpinned entries older than this are deleted on the next copy. 0 keeps them until the entry limit. Read at launch.
